title: Loring-Greenough House

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: This beloved Jamaica Plain tradition is a party, a reunion, a meeting place, a food fest, a community celebration all rolled into one. Free and open to all, Thursdays on the Lawn takes place weekly from 4pm til dusk on the grounds of the Loring Greenough House. Gardens and grass for picnicking, a beer garden for unwinding, food trucks for dining, and lots of space to play. Families, friends, neighbors, and colleagues can meet, mingle, and enjoy our beautiful green space in the heart of JP with the unbeatable backdrop of a beautiful historic house. Please join us! Thursdays on the Lawn, Oktoberfest, and The Winter Market are free and open to all but $2 donation per person, or $5 per family,

services.name: « Jamaica Plain Garden Tour
services.desc: On Sunday, June 7th, 2026 the Loring Greenough House is sponsoring a self-guided tour of beautiful private gardens in the neighborhood of Jamaica Plain. Each garden is special and unique, the result of many hours of planning and care by the homeowners. The gardens will be open from 12pm - 3pm. Visitors are invited to wander through each property, chat with the homeowner, and enjoy some light snacks. Can’t attend the tour but want to support the restoration of our Perennial Garden beds? Subscribe to our newsletter and stay informed about our talks, social activities, and other goings-on! Jamaica Plain Tuesday Club, Inc. d/b/a the Loring Greenough House is a non-profit 501(c)(3)

blurb: The Loring Greenough House was constructed in 1760 by Commodore Joshua Loring and owned by the Greenough family from 1783 until 1924. The Jamaica Plain Tuesday Club purchased the house in 1924 and has been steward ever since. In 2008, the club articulated a vibrant new community-oriented role for the House as a center for social, cultural, historical, and educational activities.

hours: "Grounds open from dawn to dusk. House tours on Sundays beginning at 13, 14, or 15."
